agentpim.cloud.title: The model runs at a provider on the internet
agentpim.cloud.text: What the AI agent reads here – mail, contacts, events and reminders – goes to that provider. With Ollama in your home network everything stays on your devices (Settings › AI agent › Connection and models).
agentpim.cloud.settings: If the model runs at a provider on the internet (Connection and models), the mail, contacts, events and reminders the AI agent reads go to that provider. With Ollama in your home network they stay on your devices.

agentpim.rights.title: Mail, events, contacts and reminders
agentpim.rights.introDesc: “Suggestions only”: the AI agent makes a draft the person opens in the program and saves or sends themselves – nothing is written. “Ask”: it waits for approval. “Do it itself”: without asking. Deleting always asks. This is the most every account gets; each account can set it stricter for itself in the AI agent app. Never through MCP or API tokens.
agentpim.action.mail.read.desc: Off: the AI agent does not see Mail at all – no reading, no draft, no sending.
agentpim.action.mail.draft: Keep a draft in the drafts folder
agentpim.action.mail.draft.desc: Write a mail without sending it.
agentpim.action.mail.send.desc: “Do it itself” only here, on its own; once the chat has read a mail, an event or a contact, sending still always asks.
agentpim.action.mail.move.desc: Into another folder; into the trash or junk always asks.
agentpim.action.event.create.desc: A new event in one of your calendars.
agentpim.action.event.update.desc: Repeating a whole series anew always asks.
agentpim.action.contact.create.desc: A new contact in the address book.
agentpim.action.contact.update.desc: Change numbers, addresses and other details.
agentpim.action.task.create.desc: A new reminder in a list.
agentpim.action.task.update.desc: Change title, notes, due date or list.
agentpim.action.task.complete.desc: Mark it done or open it again.
agentpim.mine.title: Mail, events, contacts
agentpim.mine.desc: What the AI agent may do with your mail, events, contacts and reminders
agentpim.mine.intro: An owner or administrator sets the most under Settings › AI agent › Rights. Here you can make it stricter for your account.
agentpim.act.mail.summarize.prompt: Summarize the open mail briefly: what it is about, what is expected of me and by when.
agentpim.act.mail.reply.prompt: Draft a short, friendly answer to the open mail (mail_send with reply). Send nothing without me.
agentpim.act.mail.event.prompt: Add an event from the open mail if it names one (date, time, place).
agentpim.act.mail.contact.prompt: Add the sender of the open mail as a contact, with name, address and the details of the signature. Check first whether they exist already.
agentpim.act.mail.folder.prompt: Suggest a fitting folder for the open mail (mail_folders) and move it there.
agentpim.act.calendar.free.prompt: When do I have an hour free in the next seven days (weekdays 8 am to 6 pm)?
agentpim.act.calendar.day.prompt: Give me a short overview of today: events and reminders due.
agentpim.act.calendar.week.prompt: Give me a short overview of this week: events, free time and reminders due.
agentpim.act.contacts.duplicates.prompt: Find contacts that may be duplicates and name them. Merge nothing.
agentpim.act.contacts.fromText.prompt: Add a contact from this signature or text:
agentpim.act.contacts.complete.prompt: Complete the missing details of the open contact from my mail and events, where they are clear there.
